device.name: APS storage-ring machine parameters (apstools, read only)

facts.text: ApsMachineParametersDevice is an ophyd Device of common operational parameters of the APS
The module imports Component, Device and EpicsSignalRO from ophyd
current is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV S-DCCT:CurrentM

machine_status is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV S:DesiredMode with string=True; a recorded session lists its enum strings State Unknown, USER OPERATIONS, Bm Ln Studies, INJ Studies, ASD Studies, NO BEAM and MAINTENANCE

operating_mode is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV S:ActualMode with string=True; a recorded session lists its enum strings State Unknown, NO BEAM, Injecting, Stored Beam, Delivered Beam and MAINTENANCE
shutter_status is a Component of EpicsSignalRO on PV XFD:ShutterPermit with string=True
shutters_open, fill_number and orbit_correction are Components of EpicsSignalRO on PVs NoOfShuttersOpenA, S:FillNumber and S:OrbitCorrection:CC
aps_cycle is a Component of ApsCycleDM
operator_messages is a Component of ApsOperatorMessagesDevice
ApsOperatorMessagesDevice is a Device of eight EpicsSignalRO string Components on PVs OPS:message1 to OPS:message8
inUserOperations returns whether machine_status.get() is 1, USER OPERATIONS, 2 or Bm Ln Studies
ApsCycleDM is a SynSignalRO that gets the APS cycle name from a local file

measures.description: Storage-ring current, a fresh read of PV S-DCCT:CurrentM (the IOC's engineering unit; the source states none)
measures.name: current

measures.description: Fresh string read of PV S:DesiredMode; the source states no meaning beyond the PV name
measures.name: machine_status

measures.description: Fresh string read of PV S:ActualMode; the source states no meaning beyond the PV name
measures.name: operating_mode

measures.description: Fresh string read of PV XFD:ShutterPermit; the source states no meaning beyond the PV name
measures.name: shutter_status

measures.description: Fresh read of PV NoOfShuttersOpenA (attribute shutters_open)
measures.name: shutters_open

measures.description: Fresh read of PV S:OrbitCorrection:CC; the source states no unit or meaning
measures.name: orbit_correction

measures.description: Read the storage-ring current fresh from PV S-DCCT:CurrentM (EpicsSignalRO get, use_monitor=False); no input, no effect
measures.name: read_ring_current

safe_state.description: unchanged: the package only reads PVs and never writes to the IOC; an e-stop latches the endpoint against further commands and stops nothing physical
